# ADR-3114: A10: DNS rebinding tolerance for preview fetch 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Rebinding races bypass host allow-lists.

## Decision

Previewers MUST NOT allow a DNS rebinding tolerance for preview fetch 6 (A10-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Resolve once and pin the approved IP.
